reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis that dynamic short-range order (SRO) evolution modulates dislocation mobility and enhances strength-ductility is scientifically sound and aligns with recent findings in high-entropy alloys, though the claim of simultaneous in situ neutron diffraction and TEM is technically unrealistic.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is conceptually clear but practically infeasible as written because simultaneous in situ neutron diffraction and in situ TEM cannot be performed on the same sample under the same deformation conditions.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a key mechanistic question for Co-free FeNiCrMn and proposes a controlled comparison, but the impractical test design reduces its immediate utility for guiding experiments.
